summary: Wipro Limited furnished a Form 6-K on October 20, 2026, disclosing results of operations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Gross revenue was ₹247.5 billion ($2,583.0 million), up 1.1% QoQ and 9.1% YoY; IT services revenue was $2,611.5 million, flat sequentially and up 0.6% YoY in constant currency. IT services operating margin was 16.5%, net income ₹32.0 billion ($333.9 million), EPS ₹3.23, and operating cash flow was 165.8% of net income. Total bookings were $2,595 million and large-deal bookings $674 million. Guidance for the December quarter is $2,571 million-plus. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation; there are no deal terms to watch.
